title: Background polling writes 1,730 auth_request_recovery error rows in 14 days; half end signed out
description:
## Customer impact

Mostly invisible to the customer (the fetch wrapper retries and 495 of the attempts recover), but it writes the single largest error-category telemetry stream in the product, and 609 of the attempts end without recovery, which is a customer sitting on a page whose data silently stops loading.

## Evidence (14 Bangkok days to 2026-09-12, read-only production SQL, counts only)

`TelemetryEvent name='auth_request_recovery'` (`category='error'`, `source='client'`, `step='session_refresh'`): **1,730 events**, 6 to 9 distinct accounts per day, emitted by `src/lib/authenticated-fetch.ts:84`.

| initialStatus | retryStatus | status | events |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 401 | - | `refreshing` | 1,121 |
| 401 | - | `signed_out` | 551 |
| 401 | 200 | `done` | 495 |
| 401 | - | `refresh_failed` | 56 |
| 401 | 401 | `retry_failed` | 2 |
| 401 | 201 | `done` | 1 |

So about 1,121 requests hit a 401 in 14 days; **44 % recover, 49 % end `signed_out`, 5 % `refresh_failed`**.

Which endpoints (path ids normalised, no customer identity):

| endpoint | events |
|---|---:|
| `/api/notifications` | 981 |
| `/api/editor-projects` | 352 |
| `/api/videos/usage` | 338 |
| `/api/credits/balance` | 329 |
| `/api/videos/jobs/<id>` | 142 |
| `/api/editor-projects/<id>` | 35 |
| everything else | 51 |

All of the top four are background pollers, so a single tab whose session has lapsed keeps generating rows for as long as it is open.

## Root cause hypothesis

**Unconfirmed.** Two candidates, and the data distinguishes them: (a) the pollers keep running after the session is genuinely gone, so `signed_out` is correct and the telemetry is simply the wrong severity; (b) a token refresh race means a valid session gets a 401 first and only recovers on retry, which is what the 495 `done` rows look like. Either way the event is currently `category='error'`, so it lands in the same bucket as real failures.

## Expected / actual

Expected: a background poller on a signed-out tab stops polling, and a live session does not have to retry to read its own notifications. Actual: 1,121 401s in 14 days, half of them recovered by a second request, all of them written as error telemetry.

## Acceptance criteria

* Background pollers stop after a `signed_out` outcome instead of re-polling the same endpoint.
* `auth_request_recovery` is no longer `category='error'` when the outcome is `done` (a recovered retry is not an error), or the insights classifier excludes it explicitly.
* Total `auth_request_recovery` volume falls by at least 70 % at current traffic over 7 days.
